en.MCIT（线下 on-campus，就是 csgrad 页面说的 0 基础转码项: MCIT (on-campus, the no-background career-switch program mentioned on the csgrad page) is closed. The CIS website states MCIT no longer accepts applications; the Penn Engineering master's admissions page states MCIT no longer accepts applications starting Fall 2026, and its MCIT entry has no Apply Now link or application dates. The program has been renamed Master of Applied Science in Computer Science (MAS-CS, formerly MCIT), still aimed at applicants without a CS undergrad background, with core courses carried over from MCIT. For the former MCIT track in Fall 2027, apply to MAS-CS instead. MCIT Online is also closed and replaced by MAS-CS Online
en.MIT CCSE 官网明确写明 CSE SM 项目已暂停对外招生（Externa: The MIT CCSE website explicitly states the CSE SM program has paused external admissions (External admissions ... currently paused), so no external applications are accepted for Fall 2027. Any resumption will be announced on the website. Currently only students enrolled in an MIT research SM program can apply to the CSE SM as a second degree. CCSE now admits external applicants only to two doctoral programs, CSE PhD and Dept-CSE PhD, and the MIT OGE program list also shows only the Computational Science and Engineering PhD
en.MSE-SS 从 Fall 2027 起停招，不再作为单独学位开设。CMU 把校: MSE-SS stops admitting from Fall 2027 and is no longer offered as a separate degree. CMU merged its on-campus MSE into one Master of Software Engineering degree with two options, the 16-month MSE and the 20-month MSE - Applied Study with a required summer internship, sharing one application portal. Scalable Systems becomes an optional concentration within this MSE degree. The former MSE-SS curriculum applies only to students entering in Fall 2025 and Fall 2026. The former MSE-SS application page /applicants/mse-ss/ now returns 404, and the SCS master's program list shows only Master of Software Engineering and MSE Online. For the former SS track, apply to MSE or MSE - Applied Study for Fall 2027 and choose the Scalable Systems concentration after enrolling. The deadlines, GRE, language, app fee and apply_url in this record are for the successor program and do not mean MSE-SS itself is still admitting. Also, the app fee note on the SCS admissions main page still says "MSE-ES, MSE-SS", likely outdated wording that conflicts with the program website's closure notice
